text: Given a bank account id, When xero_bank_transactions_list is called, Then the response pages spend/receive transactions newest-first (100/page) and each record carries date, type, amount, reference, bank account and IsReconciled.
Given BankAccountID, Type and Status filters, When xero_bank_transactions_list is called, Then the Xero request's where clause combines exactly those filters.
Given a bank transaction id, When xero_bank_transactions_get is called, Then it returns the single unwrapped record (line items, tax, totals, IsReconciled).
Given a bank account id and one line item, When xero_bank_transactions_create(Type=SPEND, ...) is called, Then the PUT BankTransactions body has Type=SPEND and the given account and line items.
Given a bank account id and one line item, When xero_bank_transactions_create(Type=RECEIVE, ...) is called, Then the PUT BankTransactions body has Type=RECEIVE and the given account and line items.
Given Xero returns HTTP 200 with ValidationErrors on the created bank transaction record, When xero_bank_transactions_create is called, Then the tool reports a structured error, not a success.
Given no filters, When xero_bank_transfers_list is called, Then the response pages transfers newest-first.
Given a bank transfer id, When xero_bank_transfers_get is called, Then it returns the single unwrapped record with both bank accounts, amount, date and the two linked bank-transaction ids.
Given two different bank account ids and an amount, When xero_bank_transfers_create is called, Then the PUT BankTransfers body has the right FromBankAccount, ToBankAccount, Amount and Date.
Given xero_navigate(domain="bank") is called, Then the response names the 6 new tools and a one-line summary.
Given xero_back is called, Then the "bank" domain is listed alongside the other five existing domains.
Given a non-UUID bankTransactionId, BankAccountID or bankTransferId, When any new tool is called with it, Then the response is {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument", ...}}, never a raised exception.

Given two Xero demo organisations behind two different X-Xero-Tenant-Id values, When the same new tool is called once per organisation, Then each call only returns/affects its own organisation's bank data.
steps: Obtain OAuth access tokens for two separate Xero demo/sandbox organisations (tenant A and tenant B)
Call xero_bank_transactions_list with tenant A's headers; record the returned BankTransactionIDs
Call xero_bank_transactions_list with tenant B's headers; record the returned BankTransactionIDs
Confirm the two id sets are disjoint and each organisation's bank account names match its own chart of accounts
expect: Tenant A's call never returns a record whose BankAccount belongs to tenant B's organisation, and vice versa.
notes: needs a real vendor account (two Xero sandbox organisations); not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md section 3 completion standard.

text: End-to-end pass against the Xero demo company: create a SPEND transaction, a RECEIVE transaction, and a transfer between two demo bank accounts.
steps: Authenticate against Xero's public demo company (developer.xero.com demo company OAuth flow)
Call xero_accounts_list(Type="BANK") and note two bank account ids
Open the demo company in Xero's web UI and confirm all three records appear with IsReconciled=false
expect: All three records are created without error and are visible, unreconciled, in Xero's UI under the correct bank accounts.
notes: needs a real vendor account (Xero demo company); not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md section 3 completion standard.
